summary.headline: Astrological Codex Entries 77–94
summary.text: Catalog entries 77–94 of an astrological codex, covering fixed stars, universal questions and nativities, rulers, lots of sin, fortune, daimon, marriage, and the 10th place, planetary predominators and aspects, life-span diagnosis, and Mercury in Pisces or Sagittarius. The entries cite Apomasar and Masalla, with some material marked for an appendix.
